title.full: Checking an extract or search status

summary.text: Check your application status in the e-Service using your application reference number and e-mail address.

steps.name: Open the e-Service
steps.text: Open the e-Service to check the status of your extract or search application.

steps.name: Enter your details
steps.text: Enter your application reference number and the e-mail address you provided during application.

example_phrasings: How do I check the application status for the extract or search that I had applied for?
How can I check my extract application status?
Where can I check the status of my search?

quotes.text: You may enquire the status of your extract or search application at the e-Service. You will need your application reference number and e-mail address provided during application to access this function.
